description_en: Modifies a scheduled scaling plan. This operation can be used only for AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters in elastic mode for Cluster Edition
description_zh: 调用ModifyElasticPlan修改分时弹性计划。该接口仅适用于数仓版弹性模式集群版（新版）
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-elastic-plan --db-cluster-id am-bp1rqvm70uh2v0000 --elastic-plan-name realtime --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyElasticPlan

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the scaling plan.

The name must be 2 to 30 characters in length.
The name can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/190596.html operation to query the information about all scaling plans of a cluster, including the scaling plan names
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划名称，取值说明：

长度为2~30字符。
由大写字母、小写字母、数字或下划线（_）组成。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/190596.html接口查看指定集群下所有弹性计划的详细信息，包括弹性计划名称
parameters.name: elastic_plan_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource group.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/466685.html operation to query the resource group name
parameters.help_zh:
资源组名称。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/466685.html接口查看资源组名称
parameters.name: resource_pool_name

parameters.help_en:
The number of nodes that are involved in the scaling plan.

If ElasticPlanType is set to worker, you can set this parameter to 0 or leave this parameter empty.
If ElasticPlanType is set to executorcombineworker or executor, you must set this parameter to a value that is greater than 0
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划节点数。

当ElasticPlanType为worker时，该参数可以不填写或者填写0。

当ElasticPlanType为executorcombineworker或executor时，该参数必须填写大于0的数字
parameters.name: elastic_plan_node_num

parameters.help_en: The scale-up time of the scaling plan. Specify the time on the hour in the HH:mm:ss format
parameters.help_zh: 弹性计划扩容时间，只支持设置整点时间。格式：HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: elastic_plan_time_start

parameters.help_en: The restoration time of the scaling plan. Specify the time on the hour in the HH:mm:ss format. The interval between the scale-up time and the restoration time cannot be more than 24 hours
parameters.help_zh: 弹性计划还原时间，只支持设置整点时间，与弹性计划扩容时间的间隔不能超过24小时。格式：HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: elastic_plan_time_end

parameters.help_en: The days of the week when you want to execute the scaling plan. Valid values: 0 to 6, which indicate Sunday to Saturday. Separate multiple values with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 执行弹性计划的周期。0~6表示周日到周六，多个日期用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: elastic_plan_weekly_repeat

parameters.help_en: The dates of the month when you want to execute the scaling plan. A number specifies a date of the month. Separate multiple values with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 执行弹性计划的周期。数字表示每个月的几号，多个日期用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: elastic_plan_monthly_repeat

parameters.help_en: The start date of the scaling plan. Specify the date in the yyyy-MM-dd format
parameters.help_zh: 弹性计划起始日期，格式：yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: elastic_plan_start_day

parameters.help_en: The end date of the scaling plan. Specify the date in the yyyy-MM-dd format
parameters.help_zh: 弹性计划结束日期，格式：yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: elastic_plan_end_day

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the scaling plan takes effect. Valid values:

true (default)
false
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划是否生效，取值说明：

true（默认值）：生效。
false：不生效
parameters.name: elastic_plan_enable

parameters.help_en:
The type of the scaling plan. Valid values:

worker: scales only elastic I/O resources.
executor: scales only computing resources.
executorcombineworker (default): scales both elastic I/O resources and computing resources by proportion.



If you want to set this parameter to executorcombineworker, make sure that the cluster runs a minor version of 3.1.3.2 or later.

If you want to set this parameter to worker or executor, make sure that the cluster runs a minor version of 3.1.6.1 or later and a ticket is submitted. After your request is approved, you can set this parameter to worker or executor
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划资源类型，取值说明：

worker：弹性IO资源单独弹性。
executor：计算资源单独弹性。
executorcombineworker（默认值）：计算，弹性IO资源按默认比例弹性。

如果要使用executorcombineworker，集群内核版本需为3.1.3.2及以上版本。
如果要使用worker或executor，集群内核版本需为3.1.6.1及以上版本，且需要通过提交工单申请。申请通过后，才能使用worker或executor
parameters.name: elastic_plan_type

parameters.help_en:
The resource specifications that can be scaled up by the scaling plan. Valid values:

8 Core 64 GB (default)
16 Core 64 GB
32 Core 64 GB
64 Core 128 GB
12 Core 96 GB
24 Core 96 GB
52 Core 86 GB
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划支持扩容的资源规格，取值说明：

8 Core 64 GB（默认规格）

16 Core 64 GB

32 Core 64 GB

64 Core 128 GB

12 Core 96 GB

24 Core 96 GB

52 Core 86 GB
parameters.name: elastic_plan_worker_spec
